# Career Compass Junior

Career Compass Junior is a ViTech Intelligence Solutions learning ecosystem for ages 4–18. It connects English communication with human skills, life skills, reflection, projects and age-appropriate future or career discovery.

## Public learning collection
- Career Compass Junior — Big Ideas, Bright Futures: ages 7–12, English, CEFR B1+.
- Career Compass Junior Mastery — Beginner: ages 7–12, bilingual English–Vietnamese, 96 lessons, CEFR A0–A1 progressing toward early A2.
- MY COMPASS: ages 13–18, bilingual/Vietnamese-first English + life skills + career discovery.
- EERS Action City — My First Sound Adventures: ages 4–6, early English sounds and action-based learning.
- Public author / pen name on the current editions: Zxynn Khang.

## Platform roles
- Student: interactive books, learning activities, progress, feedback and learner evidence.
- Teacher: assigned classes, attendance, assignments, submissions and structured feedback.
- Partner administrator: controlled school/training-center onboarding, classes, teacher assignment, learner enrollment and program operations.

## Public pages
- /international — main program landing page
- /books — public book catalog
- /portal/student — public student portal preview
- /portal/teacher — public teacher portal preview
- /portal/partner — public partner portal preview
- /learn/unit-1?lang=en — public interactive Unit 1 preview
- /vn — Vietnam-facing landing experience

## Privacy and access
Authenticated routes under /workspace and /auth and application APIs under /api are not public documentation surfaces and should not be indexed as public content. The LMS follows data-minimization principles; private learner data and authenticated operations are not intended for crawler access.
